title: The Prescient Archive Chamber

features.name: mirror that shows decisions already made
features.desc-on-touch: This reflection occurred before your choice. You are only now catching up to what you already did.

features.name: calendar with all dates simultaneous
features.desc-on-touch: Every day you'll ever choose this place—every day you've already chosen it. Tense collapses here.

features.name: chronometer spinning in all directions
features.desc-on-touch: Time flows forward and backward equally. The chamber remembers you will arrive before you have left.

features.name: shelves holding futures as past events
features.desc-on-touch: Every outcome sits as a filed document, dated retroactively. The choice was only ever learning which future you'd already chosen.

features.name: threshold where anticipation becomes memory
features.desc-on-touch: Standing here, you remember entering here tomorrow. Your future self is already watching you arrive.

inscription: the chamber does not predict the future; the future is already sitting here, waiting to be recognized as what you remember

file.name: Retroactive_Decision_Log_Corrupted.env
file.note: Records of choices made. All timestamps show dates in the future. All decisions recorded the day before they were first considered.

reverie.title: REVERIE — standing still while time moves around you
narr: You stood in the chamber and Katita knew—
before you knew—what you would decide. She'd
chosen this already, without choosing. She
said: some choices choose us first. We feel
like we decide them later, but we never did.
She was standing in your future. Always had.

exits.label: back to where memory is still learning to anticipate
into a chamber where consequences arrive before actions
upward toward choices not yet unmade
down to where futures wait in filing cabinets
